## Problem or Pedagogical Need
Describe the learner friction or Second Language Acquisition (SLA) gap this addresses.

## Proposed Native Implementation
Explain how this feature works within the C++20 + SDL2 + Cairo native architecture (Note: HTML/CSS/JS/WebView proposals are not permitted).

## Validation Metric
How will we measure whether this improves 4-modality retention or `<2500ms` procedural fluency?
